items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Most of the time we would go to rehearsal to play hearts. It was Syd Catlett again, Tyree Glenn, trumpet player who died, Red -- New Orleans.

ctx.x: No, she didn't hit Ben. You know. But those are some times I tell you. But any way, during this time also in the interim -- you know, when I say I worked here and I worked there, but there were intervals where we didn't work, you know. And I would rehearse with Don Redman's

band, and Don was just a beautiful guy, very talented man, very talented man. He was a musical genius. Also he played to play dirty hearts. Most of the time we would go to rehearsal to play hearts. It was Syd Catlett again, Tyree Glenn, trumpet player who died, Red -- New Orleans.
